summary: Read two singly linked chains whose stored integers already run from small to large along each chain. Attach every node from both chains into one fresh chain that also runs from small to large. Changing the pointer from a node to its successor is allowed, but changing the integer inside a node is not. Write the head of the fresh chain. Either input chain may be empty, and an empty chain supplies no nodes.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
